headline: OpenAI and Anthropic told British lawmakers to regulate AI as the UK's spy chief warned it could be used to create new bioweapons, while the US Army stood up a new Futures and Autonomy Command.

points.text: OpenAI and Anthropic leaders joined whistleblowers and security officials at a UK parliamentary session calling for AI regulation, as Britain's spy chief warned AI could be used to create new bioweapons.

The US Army converted its Futures and Concepts Command into a Futures and Autonomy Command, releasing more details about its component organization under the Defense Department's new Autonomous Warfare Command.
An OpenAI engineer was arrested after the company discovered a hidden recording device in an executive meeting room, allegedly planted with the help of a chatbot.
New data found the amount of AI-related infrastructure exposed to the public internet jumped 63% in nine months, as companies race to build with AI.
Applied Materials unveiled a multibillion-dollar chip research facility in Silicon Valley, as US chip firms bet big on R&D.
A commentary examined whether the benefits of open-weight AI models outweigh their risks, following Anthropic's recent comments on the subject.
A newsletter recapped six AI companies' White House safety accord alongside other AI safety developments, including a new introductory course on AI safety.
